platformSnapshot.note: These packages were absent from node_modules on this machine, which is what put them in the review set. That is a snapshot of one platform, not a statement about any other: an npm install on the platform an entry targets installs exactly the version and integrity pinned here.

purpose: Registry-declared license, platform targeting and dependents for the lockfile entries not installed on the machine where the notices were generated, so the notice inventory can report them without network access. scripts/third-party-notices.mjs validates every record against package-lock.json — exact key, version, integrity, and the reviewed set — and fails on anything missing, duplicated or drifted.
